title: Serve Files Safely
description: Take a file handler with the classic path traversal bug and rebuild it on os.Root, so ../ can no longer walk out of the served directory.
short_description: Close a path traversal hole with a directory handle
learning_objectives: Open a directory with os.OpenRoot and read and write through it
Explain why a filepath.Join prefix check is not enough
Recognise the path escapes from parent error
real_world_connection: Path traversal is CWE-22 and shows up in file servers, upload handlers and archive extractors every year. os.Root turns it from a validation problem into an API choice.
requirements: ReadSafe reads files inside BaseDir and refuses anything that resolves outside
WriteSafe writes inside BaseDir and refuses anything that resolves outside
Missing files inside the root still report a normal not-exist error
bonus_points: Open the root once in a struct field instead of per call and see what changes
Try root.Open("/etc/passwd") with a leading slash and read the error
